subject: ACME onboarding - provisional PO allocation, spend cap and line-item split
messages:
From: Susan Liu <susan.liu@acmeco.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@acmeco.com, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: PO assignment + spend cap mismatch on initial invoice

Hi Naomi,

We're finishing the paperwork for Redwood and running into a blocker on PO issuance. The vendor setup form (attached) lists three line items but the PO number your onboarding portal showed in our portal (reference: 0000-PLACEHOLDER) has a single aggregate spend cap of $55k. Our finance team needs the PO split so each SKU maps to the correct accounting code — otherwise we can't push the first invoice through accounts payable.

Quick questions:
- Can you confirm whether a provisional PO can be assigned so we can start the subscription kick-off?
- Can line items be split to match our ledger codes (SKU-A, SKU-B, SKU-C)?
- Is there a spend cap per SKU or only a top-level spend cap?

I've attached the onboarding form and a CSV export of the line items (acme_lineitems_v1.csv). Happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

Thanks,
Susan Liu
Sr. Procurement Manager
AcmeCo

Attachment: acme_onboard_form.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: acme_lineitems_v1.csv (CSV)

From: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
To: Susan Liu <susan.liu@acmeco.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: PO assignment + spend cap mismatch on initial invoice

Susan — thanks for the clear summary and the files, appreciated. Looping in Connor and Karthik from Procurement so they can allocate a provisional PO and confirm the ledger mapping. Ben from Finance is on Cc for the payment flow and line-item tagging.

Our suggested plan: 
1) Connor issues a provisional PO number scoped to the onboarding period so Acme can accept invoices immediately (we mark it provisional until final PO is assigned).
2) Procurement/Finance will split the PO into three line items mapping to the SKUs you shared, and set per-item spend caps if Acme requires them.
3) Finance will update the vendor ledger and confirm the accounting codes so your AP can route invoices without hold.

Connor / Karthik — can you confirm whether we should issue a single provisional PO that contains three line items (preferred) or three discrete POs per SKU (if Acme needs separate invoices)? Also attaching our internal procurement checklist for reference.

Naomi Feldman
Senior Partnerships Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: internal-proc-checklist.pdf (procurement checklist)

From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai, Susan Liu <susan.liu@acmeco.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: PO assignment + spend cap mismatch on initial invoice

On Mon, May 31, 2027 at 9:05 AM Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Connor / Karthik — can you confirm whether we should issue a single provisional PO that contains three line items (preferred) or three discrete POs per SKU (if Acme needs separate invoices)?

Thanks — we can do a single provisional PO with three explicit line items and per-line spend caps. I'll create the provisional PO now and attach the PO stub here. Details below: 

- Provisional PO: PRV-2027-ACME-00123
- Total spend cap (system): $55,000
- Line items and caps:
  * SKU-A (acct: 4001) — cap $20,000
  * SKU-B (acct: 4002) — cap $25,000
  * SKU-C (acct: 4003) — cap $10,000

Action items for Ben/Finance: mark ledger entries for PRV-2027-ACME-00123 and ensure invoices route to the above accounts. Ben — I left a note in JIRA (JIRA-PROC-4721) with the provisional PO and files.

Attachment: PRV-2027-ACME-00123-stub.pdf (PO stub)

Connor O'Brien
Procurement Coordinator
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Susan Liu <susan.liu@acmeco.com>, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: PO assignment + spend cap mismatch on initial invoice

Susan / Naomi — confirmed. I've updated the ledger and assigned the accounting codes indicated by Connor. Invoice routing rules updated so AP will accept invoices tied to PRV-2027-ACME-00123 with the three line items mapped to accounts 4001/4002/4003.

Notes: 
- If Acme prefers separate invoices per SKU we can split the provisional PO into three discrete POs, but please confirm — default behavior is single PO with per-line caps.
- I attached the ledger change ticket id for your procurement team to reference.

Ledger update ticket: JIRA-PROC-4721
Attachment: ledger-update-note.txt (internal note)

—
Ben Carter
Finance Operations Manager
